contributions.detail: Form A (on PAGE 3 of this PDF - see the page-order note) is a completely EMPTY grid: an ink projection across the full grid width returns only the 18 printed rules plus the footer caption, no handwriting in any data row. Zero rows, an honest empty schedule. Unlike the other blank-schedule filing in this chunk, this one CAN be scored, because the filer DREW a zero rather than leaving the cells empty: the schedule footer cell reads a hand-drawn slashed zero over the printed accounting dash, and so does the cover's line-1 'Total THIS Report' cell. Under the repo zero-glyph ruling a drawn slashed zero IS 0, so 0 rows = 0 = both period anchors: exact. Scope is PERIOD - the cumulative 640.20 is carried forward from an earlier report of the cycle and is not itemised here. This 2024 cover generation prints only THREE money lines, with no 'aggregate of $50.00 or less' line, so cover_le50_* are null (field absent).

expenditures.detail: Form B (on PAGE 2 of this PDF) is likewise a completely EMPTY grid - ink projection returns only the 18 printed rules and the footer caption. Zero rows. Here the two anchors DIFFER in kind and the distinction matters: the schedule footer prints only the bare accounting dash with NO handwriting over it, so schedule_total is transcribed '-' and is BLANK, not 0; but the cover's expense-line 'Total THIS Report' cell carries a hand-DRAWN slashed zero, which is 0. Scored on the cover cell: 0 rows = 0, exact, period scope. The 640.20 cumulative is a carry-forward, unitemised here.

gates.page_subtotal: Both schedules print a footer total. p3 (Form A): the filer drew a slashed zero in the TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS cell - 0 rows = 0, gate fired and closed. p2 (Form B): the TOTAL EXPENDITURES cell holds only the printed dash and no handwriting, so that cell is BLANK and no numeric gate could be fired there; the side was gated against the cover's drawn zero instead. Stated rather than invented.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py ran cleanly on both schedule pages (geometry_status 'ok'): 20 h-rules / 19 bands each = 1 header + 18 ruled data rows (the last band is the printed TOTAL footer, outside the grid rules). Independent ink projection across the full grid width returns, on BOTH pages, only thin bands (h 0.27-0.45 pct = the printed rules) between the header and the footer caption - zero data-ink bands in 18 rows on each page. 0 rows emitted on each side, as the grid holds.
